## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive (narrow/weak). SPY (1W: +2.08% | 1M: +0.82%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND show concentrated equity strength while HYG (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -1.36%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.37% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND signal credit softness — two independent confirmations of mixed signals.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress RISING: HYG/LQD falling (HYG (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -1.36%) BELOW TREND; LQD (1W: -0.37% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND). Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -7.70%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Commodities/reflation bid: CPER (1W: +5.02% | 1M: +1.55%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tighter: SPY (1W: +2.08% | 1M: +0.82%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -0.52% | 1M: -2.17%) BELOW TREND — stocks outperforming long bonds, but HYG/LQD weakness leaves conditions mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech-led but narrow: XLK (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND; QQQ (1W: +5.29% | 1M: +5.05%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +12.68% | 1M: +11.84%) ABOVE TREND. Weak Financials and Energy: XLF (1W: -3.62% | 1M: -5.68%) BELOW TREND; XLE (1W: -2.01% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND. Style: Growth (tech) showing strength but leadership is narrow.

5. US vs Global?
US pockets lead: SPY (1W: +2.08% | 1M: +0.82%) ABOVE TREND; EM participation but mixed: EEM (1W: +2.97% | 1M: +0.88%) ABOVE TREND while China FXI (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -4.18%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Elevated speculative flows: IBIT (1W: +11.25% | 1M: +7.26%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +7.52% | 1M: +4.13%) ABOVE TREND; small caps lag — IWM (1W: -0.70% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Broad commodity bid led by copper/energy: CPER (1W: +5.02% | 1M: +1.55%) ABOVE TREND, UGA (1W: +4.06% | 1M: +19.41%) ABOVE TREND, UNG (1W: +4.92% | 1M: +7.09%) ABOVE TREND. Gold is in RECOVERY: GLD (1W: +0.29% | 1M: -7.92%) RECOVERY.

8. Energy Trend?
Mixed/rotational: XLE (1W: -2.01% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND while oil ETFs show divergence — USO (1W: -4.70% | 1M: +12.57%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -5.03% | 1M: +12.19%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: XLK, QQQ, SOXX, IBIT ABOVE TREND (consistent 1W & 1M strength). MAJOR DIVERGENCES: sector breadth narrow (3/11) and oil ETFs USO/BNO show 1W vs 1M mismatch — suppresses broad Risk-On conviction.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor tech/large-cap growth exposure (XLK, QQQ) given concentrated strength; reduce exposure to lagging Financials and Energy names (XLF, XLE) and monitor credit (HYG/LQD) and breadth deterioration.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +6.69%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +12.68% | 1M: +11.84%) ABOVE TREND; QQQ (1W: +5.29% | 1M: +5.05%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -2.01% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND; XLF (1W: -3.62% | 1M: -5.68%) BELOW TREND; IWM (1W: -0.70% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +5.02% | 1M: +1.55%) ABOVE TREND; UNG (1W: +4.92% | 1M: +7.09%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH/Watch: USO (1W: -4.70% | 1M: +12.57%) CORRECTION; BNO (1W: -5.03% | 1M: +12.19%) CORRECTION — monitor 1W weakness vs 1M gains.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD spread ~0.80 (credit health signal); XLK/XLF spread 2.0 (growth vs value leadership pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, concentrated tech strength offset by narrow participation. XLK (1W: +6.44% | 1M: +6.69%) and QQQ (1W: +5.29% | 1M: +5.05%) showing strength while HYG (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -1.36%) and LQD (1W: -0.37% | 1M: -1.50%) show credit softness — key divergence to monitor (also oil ETF mismatches USO/BNO).
